clue.text: Maybe peacock's been eating mashed gruel

explanation.definitionFit: Peacock is the name of a shade of greenish blue, so it is an example of the colour.

clue.text: With no new greenfly say in garden area this is halved

clue.text: Remove bandages and walk awkwardly following guns (good going)

clue.text: The first book group?

clue.text: One who might curse with irritation
